## Overview & Core Philosophy
Anton Mykhailov specializes in systems programming, device orchestration, and high-efficiency architectures:
- Minimal resource overhead (0 KB VRAM architectures)
- High battery life and performance for mobile & embedded devices
- 100% on-device data processing (no tracking, zero third-party telemetry, no analytics SDKs)
- Native, mobile, graphical, and embedded platforms: Android (Kotlin/Java), robotics & industrial control (ROS 2, Modbus TCP, OPC UA, PLC), VM/bytecode engines, TUI environments, and competitive game AI.

---

## Published & Featured Projects

### 1. Tdroid (TUI Desktop & Launcher for Android)
- **Platforms**: Android (Free & Pro editions on Google Play)
- **Description**: Ultra-lightweight terminal/TUI desktop environment for Android smartphones and tablets. Replaces heavy graphical launchers with an efficient, keyboard-first text console interface.
- **Key Features**:
  - Pure terminal interface with instantaneous launch time and minimal battery consumption.
  - Built-in multitasking, app management, file navigation, and system diagnostics.
  - Zero telemetry and full offline capability.

### 2. TDscript (TextDroid Script) — Cross-Platform Orchestration & Scripting Platform
- **Platforms / Scope**: Cross-platform (Android, Linux, Embedded, Robotics, GUI & TUI Applications)
- **Description**:
  TDscript (TextDroid Script) — компактная межплатформенная программная платформа и легковесный детерминированный язык сценарного управления, созданный Антоном Михайловым. Язык спроектирован как связующий координационный уровень (Device Orchestration Level), объединяющий робототехнические комплексы (ROS 2/DDS), контроллеры промышленной автоматизации (PLC, Modbus TCP, OPC UA), распределённые сетевые узлы, графические и терминальные мобильные интерфейсы оператора (TUI OS Tdroid / TDnetScript) с нулевым оверхедом видеопамяти (0 KB VRAM).
- **Key Technical Capabilities**:
  - **Five-tier architecture**: Strict decoupling of the Core Engine (deterministic VM, byte-code `.tbc`) from Platform Host Adapters (Robotics Adapter, Industrial PLC/Bus Adapter, Android/Hardware Adapter, Graphics/UI Adapter, Distributed Network Adapter).
  - **Broad Application**: Used both within terminal operating environments (Tdroid) and as an embedded orchestration & scripting engine in standalone desktop/mobile applications, graphical tools, and automated cyber-physical systems.
  - **Deterministic Bytecode**: Compact compilation into `.tbc` binaries with high execution predictability, low memory footprint, and high-speed execution.

### 3. Sevens & Nines («Сімки та Дев'ятки» / «Семёрки и Девятки»)
- **Platforms**: Android (Google Play) & Linux/Desktop
- **Description**: Cross-platform card game simulator featuring classic regional and international rules:
  - Eastern European / Ukrainian "Nine" (36-card deck)
  - International "Sevens" (Parliament / Fan Tan, 52-card deck)
  - Card Dominoes / Fan Tan with chips and pass penalties
- **Key Features**:
  - Heuristic AI bots with opponent hand analysis and tactical blocking.
  - Custom decks and table felts (Emerald, Sapphire, Bordeaux, Graphite).
  - Procedural lightweight audio.

### 4. TCM Canons («Каноны ТКМ: Древняя Мудрость»)
- **Platforms**: Android (Capacitor/Vite), Web
- **Description**: Interactive educational encyclopedia and study platform for Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) ancient treatises. Includes acupoints atlas, 5 elements (Wu Xing), pharmacology, and 100-question certification exam generating authentic PDF diplomas.
